To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed a series of selective and non-selective etchants for GaAsSb-based materials, and the applicability of the etch rates and selectivities for the etching of these materials was proved by substrate removal experiments.

the selectivity of the wet-chemical etchant C4H4 KNaO6:H2O:HCl:H2O 2 for GaSb and AlAsSb (5:1) and GaSb and GaInAs (15:1) is sufficient for the fabrication of the GaSb/InAsSb/GaSb quantum well structures.
we have developed selective wet-chemical etching solutions for the GaSb material system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of wet-chemical processes for the preparation of GaSb-based heterostructures and quantum well structures for the use in optoelectronic devices.
the investigation of wet-chemical selective etchants for GaInSb/InAsSb-based material systems.
the investigation of wet-chemical solutions for etching of GaSb-based alloys.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the C4H4 KNaO6:H2O2: HCl: H2 O etchant is the most versatile etchant for GaSb based materials, as it etches all materials with different etch rates.
the C4H4 KNaO6:H2O2: HCl:H20 etchant has the best properties for selective etching of GaSb versus InAs and InAsSb.
the etch solution C4H4 KNaO6:H2O2: HCl:H20 (1.5:1:0.1:1) is the most suitable for the selective removal of GaSb from AlAsSb and/or InAsSb.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
C4H4 KNaO6 is a selective etchant for GaSb and AlAsSb and a non-selective etchant for InAsSb, whereas C6H8 O7 is non-selective for all materials.
the C4H4O6KNa:HCl:H2O: H2O etchant is the most promising one for selective etching of InAsSb on GaSb.
the C4H4 KNaO6 based etchant has a very good selectivity for GaSb and AlAsSb and a moderate selectivity for InAsSb, while the C6H8 O7 based etchant has very good selectivity between GaAs and InAs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to selectively etch GaSb, InSb and AlSb-based materials using wet-chemical etching.
the C4H4O6KNa:HCl:H2O:H2O2 solution etches GaSb with the highest selectivity to AlAsSb and to InAsSb, and the C6H8H7:H2O:HCl:H2Cl2 etch solution etches InAsSb with the best selectivity to GaSb.
a selective etching of the InAsSb layer with a GaSb surface is possible.
